entries.title: Psalms 46:1
segments: To the Chief Musician. For the sons of Korah. A Song "For the Virgins." God [is] our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.

entries.title: Psalms 46:2
segments: Therefore we will not fear when the earth changes, and when mountains [are] slipping into the heart of the seas.

entries.title: Psalms 46:3
segments: Let its waters roar and foam; let the mountains shake with the swelling of it. Selah.

entries.title: Psalms 46:4
segments: [There is] a river, its channels gladden the city of God glad, the holy [place] of the tabernacles of the Most High.

entries.title: Psalms 46:5
segments: God [is] in the midst of her; she shall not be moved; God shall help her at the turning of the morning.

entries.title: Psalms 46:6
segments: The nations raged, the kingdoms were shaken; He uttered His voice, the earth melted.

entries.title: Psalms 46:7
segments: The LORD of hosts [is] with us; the God of Jacob [is] our refuge. Selah.

entries.title: Psalms 46:8
segments: Come, behold the works of the LORD, who makes ruins on the earth;

entries.title: Psalms 46:9
segments: who makes wars to cease to the ends of the earth; He breaks the bow, and cuts the spear in two; He burns the chariots in the fire.

entries.title: Psalms 46:10
segments: Be still, and know that I [am] God! I will be praised among the nations, I will be praised in the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 46:11
segments: The LORD of hosts [is] with us; the God of Jacob [is] our refuge. Selah.
